edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Ordinary singular you/your replaces thee/thou/thy to Gaius; modern third-person verbs restored. Talking malicious nonsense about us in 1:10 smooths the chattering/evil-words clause without dropping the charge. Gaius, Diotrephes and Demetrius remain named. The truth/walking repetitions, well-being prayer, stranger-brothers, the Name, fellow workers, testimony and individual final greetings remain. Fifteen existing verse anchors follow the consulted numbering; the final greetings are not merged into verse 14.
chapters.focus: Read all 15 English and displayed Greek verses; focused comparison of singular address, the well-being wish, the Name, Diotrephes’s actions, the testimony to Demetrius and the closing 14–15 numbering.
chapters.running_text_read: Displayed NA28 running text read; focused comparison of the recorded features, not an exhaustive apparatus collation.
chapters.pending: Review your truth/truthfulness in 1:3, the dative with the truth in 1:8, the reception/support terminology and the scope of the personal well-being wish in 1:2. Face to face in 1:14 renders literal mouth to mouth; the literal expression is recorded in notes. Full UBS6/ECM and apparatus comparison, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
